```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
library(vcfR)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
phenotype <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/221_acc_superfamilies_blups_per_te/associations_exploring/expression_per_superfamily.csv", sep=" ", header=T)

#raw_expression <- fread("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/221_acc_superfamilies_blups_per_te/associations_exploring/raw_expression_per.csv", header=T)
# Genotype
vcf <- read.vcfR("/groups/nordborg/projects/ddm1_resilencing/03_processing/006_gwas/all_plates_96w/gemma_gwas/221_acc_superfamilies_blups_per_te/associations_exploring/chr5_7193242_ltr_copia_ddm1.vcf")

# Extract genotypes
gt <- extract.gt(vcf, element = "GT")

# Convert to dataframe
snp_data <- data.frame(
  accession = colnames(gt),
  genotype = as.vector(gt[1, ])  # First (and only) SNP
) %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert genotype to numeric (0/0 = 0, 0/1 = 1, 1/1 = 2)
    genotype_numeric = case_when(
      genotype == "0/0" ~ 0,
      genotype == "0/1" ~ 1,
      genotype == "1/0" ~ 1,
      genotype == "1/1" ~ 2,
      genotype == "./." ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Convert to factor for plotting
    genotype_factor = factor(genotype_numeric, 
                            levels = c(0, 1, 2,3),
                            labels = c("Ref/Ref", "Ref/Alt", "Alt/Alt","NA"))
  )

# View
head(snp_data)
```
## Get phenotype 
```{r}
snp_data$accession<-as.numeric(snp_data$accession)
snp_data_with_phenotype <-inner_join(snp_data,phenotype,by=c("accession"))

```



```{r}
snp_data_with_phenotype <-snp_data_with_phenotype[snp_data_with_phenotype$Transposon_Super_Family=="LTR/Copia",]
ggplot(snp_data_with_phenotype %>% filter(!is.na(genotype_factor), !is.na(ddm1_log2_expr)), 
       aes(x = genotype_factor, y = ddm1_log2_expr, fill = genotype_factor)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Ref/Ref" = "#9BC09C", "Alt/Alt" = "#C5172E", "Ref/Alt"="blue")) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", 
                     comparisons = list(c("Ref/Ref", "Alt/Alt")),
                     label = "p.format",  # Shows p = 0.001
                     bracket.size = 0.6,
                     size = 5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "F1 ddm1 chr5_7193242", x = "Genotype", y = "F1 ddm1 log2expr", fill = "Genotype")
```

## Variance explained of the phenotype by the SNP 
```{r}
# ANOVA approach
anova_result <- aov(ddm1_log2_expr ~ genotype_factor, data = snp_data_with_phenotype)
summary(anova_result)

SS_genotype <- 0.394
SS_residual <- 6.976
SS_total <- SS_genotype + SS_residual

R_squared <- SS_genotype / SS_total
cat("Variance explained (R²):", round(R_squared * 100, 2), "%\n")
```

```{r}
# Code genotypes numerically (0, 1, 2 for alt allele count)
snp_data_with_phenotype$genotype_numeric <- ifelse(snp_data_with_phenotype$genotype_factor == "Ref/Ref", 0,
                                                     ifelse(snp_data_with_phenotype$genotype_factor == "Ref/Alt", 1, 2))

# Additive model
additive_model <- lm(ddm1_log2_expr ~ genotype_numeric, data = snp_data_with_phenotype)
summary(additive_model)

# Beta coefficient = effect per alt allele
coef(additive_model)["genotype_numeric"]
confint(additive_model)["genotype_numeric", ]  # ALT allele decreases ddm1 expression 
```

```{r}
## Get alt allele genotypes
snp_data_with_phenotype_alt <-snp_data_with_phenotype[snp_data_with_phenotype$genotype=="1/1",] %>% na.omit()

```

## Connect to the raw expression as well
```{r}
raw_expression_avg <- raw_expression %>% group_by(Transposon_Super_Family, accession,genotype)%>% summarise(mean_expr=mean(expression_value), mean_transformed=mean(transformed))

# Calculate differences
expr_diff <- raw_expression_avg %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Transposon_Super_Family, accession),
    names_from = genotype,
    values_from = c(mean_expr, mean_transformed)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_expr = mean_expr_ddm1 - mean_expr_Col,
    diff_transformed = mean_transformed_ddm1 - mean_transformed_Col
  )

# View result
head(expr_diff)
```

```{r}
expr_diff_with_raw <- inner_join(expr_diff,snp_data_with_phenotype, by=c("accession") )


expr_diff_with_raw %>% 
  filter(Transposon_Super_Family == "DNA/En-Spm", !is.na(genotype_factor), !is.na(diff_transformed)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = genotype_factor, y = diff_transformed, fill = genotype_factor)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Ref/Ref" = "#9BC09C", "Alt/Alt" = "#C5172E")) +
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", 
                     comparisons = list(c("Ref/Ref", "Alt/Alt")),
                     label = "p.format",
                     bracket.size = 0.6,
                     size = 5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "F1 ddm1 raw - F1 Col raw", 
       x = "Genotype", 
       y = "F1 ddm1 raw - F1 Col raw", 
       fill = "Genotype")
```

```{r}
phenotype_long$Replicate <- as.factor(phenotype_long$Replicate)
```


```{r}
library(ggpubr)
# Perform Wilcoxon test for each replicate
phenotype_long <- na.omit(phenotype_long)
phenotype_long$Value <- as.numeric(phenotype_long$Value)
wilcox_results <- phenotype_long %>%
  group_by(Replicate) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    p_value = wilcox.test(Value ~ V2)$p.value
  )

# Print results
print(wilcox_results)


phenotype_long$Replicate <- factor(phenotype_long$Replicate,
                                 levels = c("rep1", "rep2", "rep3", "rep4","blups"),
                                 labels = c("rep1", "rep2", "rep3", "average", "blups"))


# Create the plot with renamed facet
phenotype_long$V2 <- as.factor(phenotype_long$V2)
ggplot(phenotype_long, aes(x=V2, y=Value, fill=V2)) + 
    geom_boxplot(notch=F, alpha=0.3,outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color=V2), alpha=0.8, width=0.2) +
    facet_wrap(~Replicate, scales="free_y", ncol=5) +
    stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test",
                      comparisons = list(c("0", "1")),
                      label = "p.signif") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(x="Allele", y="Expression", fill="Allele", color="Allele")+scale_fill_discrete(labels = c("Col0", "Alternative")) +
scale_color_discrete(labels = c("Col0", "Alternative"))
